purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Miyun

queries.query: Miyun Beijing China official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS
queries.result: Found first-party Beijing policy describing the official cadastral-map query service, and the official Beijing 12345 service map entry for Miyun District Real Estate Registration Center. The policy states that cadastral/parcel-map queries are available through the Beijing online real-estate registration platform, with identity authentication for the visual building query; no anonymous parcel feature endpoint was established.

queries.query: 密云区 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地图 官方
queries.result: Found the official Miyun District Real Estate Registration Center listing and Beijing’s official notice on cadastral-map and parcel-plan queries. The notice says public cadastral-area/subarea information and parcel-plan lookups exist, while visual building lookup requires Beijing Tong, Yizhengtong, or electronic business-license authentication. No public anonymous parcel ID+geometry response was verified.

registryEvidence.basis: The official Beijing 12345 service map identifies the Miyun District Real Estate Registration Center at 北京市密云区新东路285号 and states that district centers perform real-estate registration事务性工作 for their administrative areas. This is local registry-custodian evidence, separate from general national-agency prose.

officialSources.observation: First-party Beijing service-map entry for 北京市密云区不动产登记中心; identifies local address, phone, opening hours, and district registration responsibility.

First-party Beijing notice states that anyone may query cadastral districts/subdistricts and use the online platform’s parcel-plan query with parcel code, real-estate unit number, or location; it also describes identity/document limits for protected details.

First-party Beijing notice describes the visual real-estate/cadastral query service and says the visual building query requires Beijing Tong, Yizhengtong, or electronic business-license authentication.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Miyun District local registration center and Beijing municipal cadastral-query services as described by first-party sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous city-bounded parcel feature response was retrieved; no CRS, schema, native parcel identity, or safe polygon sample was available.

remainingUncertainty: The official service may expose parcel plans or additional map routes after permitted identity authentication, and the public cadastral-district query may not provide polygon geometry. A zero exact-point result, unavailable hostname, or authentication boundary is not evidence of citywide absence. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or owner/address/contact/titleholder/tax/account fields were used.
